notes: ACCESS: plain curl with a Chrome124 UA got HTTP 200 on every URL needed (www.potterybarn.in 301s -> potterybarn.in via Cloudflare; no bot-block hit). robots.txt (https://potterybarn.in/robots.txt) has one generic 'User-agent: *' group disallowing /dashboard/, /order/, /profile/*, /cart/, /thankyou/, /order-tracking/, /products/?*, /brands/?*, /collections* (plural, promo listing routes) and a Sitemap directive; it names no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web section. Every URL fetched here is a singular /collection/<slug> page, which is never matched by the disallow list, so nothing was blocked. PLATFORM: response headers carry a CSP allowing frame-ancestors *.fynd.com and the HTML confirms this store runs on India's Fynd/Jio commerce SaaS (Reliance-operated storefront), completely different from Pottery Barn US's Akamai+Constructor.io stack seen in b3.json -- confirms this had to be verified independently, not assumed identical, per the task note. TREE: sitemap.xml's category_l1/l2/l3 sitemaps only contain placeholder test-slugs (dept=fashion, l1_category=test-l1) so were useless; the real taxonomy is a full JSON nav tree server-rendered inline on every page (search for '"display":"Bath"'). That JSON was read directly: Bath has exactly two children -- 'Bath Linens' (Bath Towels & Mats / Hand Towels / Robes & Slippers, all textile -> ROUTED TO TEXTILE per rule 15/20, not recorded here) and 'Bathroom Accessories' (one child: 'Countertop Accessories'). No Bathroom Furniture/Fixtures/Storage/Mirrors/Showers/Taps/Toilets/Vanities/Sinks/Tubs section exists anywhere in the site's ~213-node nav (checked every display label plus targeted greps for vanit/mirror/shower/toilet/faucet/tap/tub/sink/basin) -- this India storefront curates only a soft-goods + decor assortment of the Pottery Barn US catalog, no sanitaryware/fixtures range at all. The only other 'mirror' nodes on the site sit under the unrelated top-level 'Mirrors & Art' section (Wall Mirrors, Floor Mirrors) which is generic home-decor, not bathroom-hierarchy -> not Bathroom per rule 11/29 (hierarchy decides), logged to review for completeness. QTY: Fynd's SSR embeds the listing pagination state inline as item_total (has_next:false confirms it is the true total, not a page size) -- verified 'Bathroom Accessories' page and 'Countertop Accessories' page both return item_total:7 (identical set), confirming Bathroom Accessories has zero products of its own beyond its one subcategory, so per rule 24 the parent is recorded only as a grouping row and 'Countertop Accessories' (qty 7) as the leaf. Spot-checked product names on that page (e.g. 'Black Handcrafted Marble Bathroom Accessories') confirming genuine bathroom items. DEDUP: checked cross_category_url_index.json for both URLs -- no hit, no prior extraction. EXCLUSIONS logged to review[]: 3 Bath Linens subcats (textile, not bathroom) and 2 generic Mirrors & Art subcats (decor mirrors, not bathroom hierarchy).
